nutrition.mpIntroDefault: Dear {name}, here are your recommendations for a healthy eating plan based on what you shared with us. It takes your preferences and lifestyle into account so you can reach your goal. Pick freely between the options in each meal category, and reach out any time you have a question.
nutrition.mpIntroClosing: Enjoy these recipes, and if you have any questions about this plan, do not hesitate to reach out. All the best!
nutrition.mpDisclaimer: Please note that this meal plan only serves as a suggestion of healthy eating patterns and is not intended to replace dietary counseling from a dietitian, nutritionist, or medical professional. Use of all meal plans is at your own risk. Always review the contents for anything you may be allergic or intolerant to. Following a meal plan does not guarantee any particular health outcome, including weight loss. If you have specific questions about your health or your individual nutrient needs, please consult your medical provider, especially if you are being treated for a medical condition.
nutrition.mpDeficitNote: Because your goal is to lose weight, your body should be in a gentle calorie deficit; this plan is built for that.
nutrition.mpEnergyNote: Your targets come from your basal metabolic rate, activity level, and goal. Protein and carbs provide about 4 kcal per gram and fat about 9 kcal per gram; the recipes in each category are built so any option keeps your day on target.
nutrition.mpTipWeigh: Ingredient amounts are RAW weight unless stated otherwise. Weigh before cooking, and only the part you will actually eat.
nutrition.mpTipSpices: Spices and seasonings are there for flavor. Swap or skip any you dislike; just read labels if you have allergies.
nutrition.mpTipPrep: Prep several portions at once: multiply a recipe, portion into containers, fridge for a few days or freeze for later.
nutrition.mpTipWeekly: It is what you eat over the WEEK that determines results, not any single meal. Be flexible with meal times; find the rhythm that fits your life.

disclaimer.title: Before you begin
disclaimer.p1: Thick & Fit provides fitness and nutrition guidance for general wellness. It is not medical advice and is not a substitute for care from a licensed healthcare provider.
disclaimer.p2: Consult your doctor before starting any exercise or nutrition program, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, or have a medical condition. Stop and seek help if you feel pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
disclaimer.p3: By continuing, you confirm you are at least 18, are participating voluntarily, and accept the risks of physical activity.
